newsitem.title: USA: Air Express, Toy Shippers Assoc sign deal.
newsitem.headline: Air Express, Toy Shippers Assoc sign deal.

text.p: Air Express International Corp on Wednesday said it signed a deal with the nation's largest toy importing group to move members' shipments from Asia to the United States.

More than 100 members of the Toy Shippers Association will be permitted to ship at negotiated rates regardless of the volume they ship with Air Express, the company said. Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
Association members using the service will be able to track their shipments on a real-time basis over the Internet, it said.
The Toy Shippers Association, based in Cincinnati, negotiates contract rates for various services on behalf of members.
